info.title: VisaAI Partner API
info.description:
The VisaAI Partner API lets approved organizations integrate with the
immigration platform.

Authentication is an API key or an OAuth 2.0 access token, presented as
`Authorization: Bearer <credential>`. Every endpoint requires a scope;
anything touching a user’s immigration data additionally requires that
user’s recorded consent.

Two environments. Sandbox credentials (`vak_test_…`) read synthetic data
and can never reach production records.

post.description: Supports `client_credentials` and `authorization_code` (PKCE, S256 only). The password and implicit grants are not supported.
Always returns 200, per RFC 7009, so the endpoint cannot be used to test whether a token is live.
Returns the signing secret exactly once. The endpoint starts in `pending_verification` and must be verified before it receives events.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Optional. Replaying the same key with the same body returns the original response instead of repeating the operation.

post.description: We POST `{"type":"endpoint.verification","challenge":"…"}`. Respond 2xx echoing the challenge value.
The previous secret keeps signing alongside the new one until `previousValidUntil`, so you can roll your verifier without dropping events.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Page size. Values above 100 are clamped.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor from `next_cursor` on the previous page.

parameters.name: user_id
parameters.description: Required for client-credentials tokens. Omitted for user-consented tokens, which already name their subject.

bearerAuth.description: An API key (`vak_live_…` / `vak_test_…`) or an OAuth access token (`vat_…`).

scope.description: Space-delimited. Known scopes: partner:read, usage:read, webhooks:read, webhooks:write, applications:read, applications:write, documents:read, consents:read

url.description: Absolute https URL. Private, loopback and link-local destinations are rejected.

secret.description: Signing secret. Shown once and never retrievable again.

WebhookPayload.description: The signed body delivered to your endpoint. Verify `V-Signature` before trusting it.

x-scopes.description: Read your own partner identity, application and scopes
Read your API usage, rate-limit and quota status
List webhook endpoints and delivery history
Create, update, rotate and delete webhook endpoints
Read a consenting user's visa applications and their status
Create a visa application on behalf of a consenting user
Read document metadata and processing status (never document contents)
Read which users have granted your application access
